interpretation: The source shell lacks adjacent faces along these particular edges. No amount of vertex snapping or edge subdivision can create a mating edge without adding/reconstructing faces. The minimal repair retained the candidate source-open-boundary faces in Bodywork_MainShell and limited the removable panel to the adjacent connected region. No faces were duplicated or added.
